competencyTargets.label: Issue environmental permits and resource-use authorizations as the deciding authority
Map the decision authority and procedural pathway for a proposed action
Build and maintain a defensible administrative record
Negotiate permit conditions, mitigation and agreements using interest-based methods
Process permit applications and administer issued authorizations
Operate within, or oversee, delegated and assumed regulatory programs
Track regulatory change and translate it into operating guidance
Validate AI-generated work products before professional use
Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments
Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary
Maintain the integrity of regulatory and scientific findings under institutional pressure
Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty
Assess litigation exposure and design decisions for resilience on remand
Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work
Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work
Record provenance and AI involvement in work products
Supervise staff and volunteers in environmental work
Design accessible, inclusive public engagement and services

topTasks.statement: Review a permit application for administrative and technical completeness, issuing a deficiency notice that lists each missing element and its basis
Derive permit limits and conditions from the applicable technical standards and the facility's technical record, documenting the calculation basis for each limit
Draft a permit and its fact sheet so that each condition is measurable, enforceable and traceable to its legal or technical basis
Review an AI-drafted permit or fact sheet against the application record and permit template, correcting each condition that lacks a traceable basis
Respond to public comments on a draft permit, revising conditions where a comment shows an error and explaining each decision in the response document
Write policy or instrument language that states each obligation, obligated party, deadline and verification method so that compliance can be determined
Test draft permit conditions or agreement terms against compliance-verification and legal-challenge scenarios, recording each term revised and why
Verify each term of an AI-generated first draft of an instrument against the governing authority and record before the draft enters review
Review a project proposal to identify every authorization, consultation and review it triggers, recording the governing procedure version for each
Prepare an authority map and pathway plan for a multi-permit project, sequencing concurrent and dependent decisions and identifying the critical path
Negotiate permit conditions or mitigation with an applicant, generating options that meet the governing requirements and recording the agreed terms
Prepare a negotiation brief stating own and counterpart interests, alternatives to agreement, the issue list and the limits of one's authority
